cards.text: David is king, and a delivery shows up from Hiram, king of Tyre. Envoys, cedar logs, stonemasons AND carpenters. Friend, that's not a gift basket, that's a whole construction crew.

cards.question: Hiram's stonemasons and carpenters roll in with cedar logs. What did Hiram send them to build for David?

cards.text: Friend, give me ONE new rolling pin and I strut around this bakery for a week. But David? He realizes where all this really came from, and who it's for.

cards.question: David realizes the LORD has made him king over Israel and lifted his kingdom high for the sake of His ___.

cards.text: In Jerusalem, David takes more wives and has more sons and daughters, and the list of children born there runs thirteen names long, Solomon included. THIRTEEN, friend, and I thought six cookie cutters made a crowded counter.

The Philistines, the people Goliath came from (1 Samuel 17:4), hear David's been anointed king over all Israel, and they all go out searching for him. And trust me, friend, these folks are NOT bringing cedar logs.

cards.question: David learns the Philistines are searching for him, so he hides until they give up and go home.

cards.text: The Philistines come and raid the Valley of Rephaim. Before David goes up against them, there's something he does first.

cards.question: The Philistines are raiding the Valley of Rephaim. What does David do before he goes up against them?

answers.text: He asks God what to do
He sends gifts to make peace

cards.question: When David asks, the LORD promises to deliver the Philistines into his hand.

cards.text: So David and his men go up to Baal-perazim, and David defeats the Philistines. Just like God said, JUST like He said.

cards.question: After the win at Baal-perazim, David gives the credit to the courage of his men.

cards.text: David says, “Like a bursting flood, God has burst out against my enemies by my hand.” Then the Philistines leave something behind there, something they should NEVER leave behind.

cards.question: The Philistines leave something behind at Baal-perazim. What do they abandon there?
The Philistines left their gods behind at Baal-perazim. What does David order done with them?

cards.text: But the Philistines aren't done, and once again they raid the valley. It's the snooze button all over again: you KNOW it's coming back.

cards.question: With the Philistines back in the valley, David skips asking God this time, since he already won once.

cards.text: David asks God again, and God answers. And this time, God gives him a whole plan.

cards.question: God gives David a plan for the second Philistine raid. What is it?

answers.text: Circle around and attack by the balsam trees
Wait for them back in Jerusalem

cards.text: Then God gives David a signal to listen for: the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees.

cards.question: God tells David to listen for marching in the tops of the balsam trees. As soon as David hears it, what is he to do?
When David hears marching in the tops of the balsam trees, what does God say it will mean?

answers.text: God has gone out ahead of him
His army is ready to fight

cards.question: With God's plan and signal in hand, David does exactly as God commanded him.

cards.text: So they strike down the Philistine army all the way from Gibeon to Gezer. Friend, when the signal is coming from the TREETOPS, you do not freestyle.
And after all that, David's fame goes out into every land. Every. Single. One.

cards.question: As David's fame spreads, the ___ causes all the nations to fear him.
